rewriteBeforeAnswers: Fix the quoting in `report_csv` in `export.py`. It joins fields with an f-string, so a payee like 'Smith, John' splits the row. Use proper CSV quoting so a comma inside a field stays in one column. Done when `python3 run_tests.py` passes and that payee comes out as a single column.
